Lombalgia in RM (3/6): uomo, guarda l'al: Low back pain on MRI (3/6): man, check the alignment
Anterolistesi di L5 su S1 di grado I con: Grade I anterolisthesis of L5 on S1 with a collapsed L5-S1 disc (Pfirrmann 5); L4-L5 degeneration with Modic 2 (SPIDER 7)
Uomo con storia di lombalgia. RM del rac: Man with a history of low back pain. Lumbar spine MRI without contrast: sagittal T1 and T2. Age and other clinical data are not available in the collection.
Valuta l'allineamento dei muri posterior: Assess the alignment of the posterior walls and the lower lumbar discs.
La spondilolistesi è lo scivolamento di:
Spondylolisthesis is the slip of one vertebra over the one below. Look at the posterior wall line: it should be continuous. The grade is measured with Meyerding (I to V, by quarters of the endplate of the vertebra below).
There are two main causes: degenerative (facet arthropathy, most often at L4-L5, intact pars) and isthmic (spondylolysis, a defect of the pars interarticularis, most often at L5-S1). In the isthmic form the posterior arch stays behind and the canal widens; in the degenerative form the canal narrows.
The pars is assessed on parasagittal images and, better, on CT; here the collection only gives the presence of the listhesis and the MRI does not allow a conclusion on the cause.
Modic endplate changes accompany disc degeneration: type 1 (oedema) is the one most often associated with pain.
Muri posteriori in fila: se uno scalino: Posterior walls in line: if there is a step, measure the grade and look for the cause.
Gradazioni del radiologo muscoloscheletr: Grading by the SPIDER collection musculoskeletal radiologist: L5-S1 spondylolisthesis, lower endplate change, disc narrowing, bulge, Pfirrmann 5; L4-L5 Modic 2, endplate change, disc narrowing, bulge, Pfirrmann 5; L3-L4 disc narrowing and bulge, Pfirrmann 3; upper levels Pfirrmann 2.
T2 sagittale mediana: scalino tra i muri: Midline sagittal T2: step between the posterior walls of L5 and S1
Qual è la conclusione più adatta?: What is the most appropriate conclusion?
L5 scivolata in avanti rispetto a S1 (an: L5 slipped forward relative to S1 (anterolisthesis), with a thin, dark L5-S1 disc
Serie 1 (T2), immagini 7-10: il muro pos: Series 1 (T2), images 7-10: the posterior wall of L5 lies about 5-7 mm in front of that of S1; the L5-S1 disc is very low and black (Pfirrmann 5 in the collection grading).
Disco L4-L5 degenerato con alterazioni d: Degenerated L4-L5 disc with changes of the adjacent endplates (bright on T1: Modic 2)
Serie 0 (T1), immagini 6-8: banda chiara: Series 0 (T1), images 6-8: bright band below the inferior endplate of L4. Modic 2 = fatty replacement of the marrow next to the endplate (bright on T1 and T2); Modic 1 = oedema (dark on T1, bright on T2); Modic 3 = sclerosis (dark on both).
L5 ha altezza conservata: è spostata in: L5 has preserved height: it is displaced forwards, not compressed.
Lo scivolamento è a L5-S1 ed è in avanti: The slip is at L5-S1 and it is forwards.
Grado I di Meyerding: scivolamento fino: Meyerding grade I: slip up to 25% of the S1 superior endplate
Si misura quanto il muro posteriore di L: Measure how far the posterior wall of L5 has moved forward relative to that of S1, as a percentage of the S1 endplate length: I up to 25%, II 25-50%, III 50-75%, IV 75-100%, V beyond (spondyloptosis). Here about 15-20%.
Grado III di Meyerding: oltre metà del p: Meyerding grade III: more than half of the endplate
Lo spostamento è di pochi millimetri, be: The displacement is a few millimetres, well under half of the endplate.
Anterolistesi di L5 su S1 di grado I con: Grade I anterolisthesis of L5 on S1 with a collapsed L5-S1 disc; L4-L5 degeneration. The pars (spondylolysis) needs parasagittal images or CT
